purpose: private authored activity pilot; not learner-facing

activities.cueEnglish: Find whether this roof is flat or sloped.
activities.modelFrench: Ce toit est en pente, pas plat.
activities.modelEnglish: This roof is sloped, not flat.

activities.cueEnglish: Without looking, name the roof system in French.
activities.modelFrench: le système de couverture

activities.cueEnglish: Listen and identify the word for skylight.
activities.modelFrench: la fenêtre de toit

activities.cueEnglish: Type 'Is the roof flat or sloped?' in French.
activities.modelFrench: Le toit est-il plat ou en pente ?
activities.modelEnglish: Is the roof flat or sloped?

activities.cueEnglish: Ask the crew what material covers this roof.
activities.modelFrench: Le chef d’équipe demande : « Quel matériau couvre ce toit ? »
activities.modelEnglish: The foreman asks: What material does this roof have?

activities.cueEnglish: Write where the skylight is located.
activities.modelFrench: Il y a aussi une fenêtre de toit à l’arrière.
activities.modelEnglish: There is also a skylight at the back.

activities.cueEnglish: Find what the roof deck is made of.
activities.modelFrench: En bas se trouve le support de couverture, en contreplaqué.
activities.modelEnglish: At the bottom is the roof deck, which is plywood.

activities.cueEnglish: Without looking, name the underlayment in French.
activities.modelFrench: la sous-couche

activities.cueEnglish: Listen and identify the term for drip edge.
activities.modelFrench: le larmier

activities.cueEnglish: Type 'Roll out the underlayment.' in French.
activities.modelFrench: Déroulez la sous-couche.

activities.cueEnglish: Ask where the drip edge goes.
activities.modelFrench: Le chef d’équipe demande : « Où doit-on poser le larmier ? »
activities.modelEnglish: The foreman asks: Where does the drip edge go?

activities.cueEnglish: Write which layer goes on top of the deck.
activities.modelFrench: La sous-couche se pose par-dessus, par exemple du feutre bitumé.
activities.modelEnglish: The underlayment goes on top, for example felt paper.

activities.cueEnglish: Find where the step flashing is placed in this scene.
activities.modelFrench: Ici, un solin à gradins est posé près du mur.
activities.modelEnglish: Here there is step flashing next to the wall.

activities.cueEnglish: Without looking, name the roof valley in French.
activities.modelFrench: la noue

activities.cueEnglish: Listen and identify the word for leak.
activities.modelFrench: la fuite

activities.cueEnglish: Type 'Show me where the flashing goes.' in French.
activities.modelFrench: Montrez-moi où doit aller le solin.
activities.modelEnglish: Show me where the flashing goes.

activities.cueEnglish: Ask where the valleys are on this roof.
activities.modelFrench: Le chef d’équipe demande : « Où se trouvent les noues sur ce toit ? »
activities.modelEnglish: The foreman asks: Where are the valleys on this roof?

activities.cueEnglish: Write what the flashing helps prevent.
activities.modelFrench: Le solin aide à empêcher l’eau de pénétrer.
activities.modelEnglish: Flashing helps keep the water out.

activities.cueEnglish: Find where the ridge vent runs.
activities.modelFrench: L’évent de faîtage longe le faîtage.
activities.modelEnglish: The ridge vent goes along the ridge.

activities.cueEnglish: Without looking, name the downspout in French.
activities.modelFrench: la descente pluviale

activities.cueEnglish: Listen and identify the term for ridge vent.
activities.modelFrench: l’évent de faîtage

activities.cueEnglish: Type 'Where does the downspout go?' in French.
activities.modelFrench: Où se place la descente pluviale ?

activities.cueEnglish: Ask a coworker where the downspout goes.
activities.modelFrench: Où se place la descente pluviale ?

activities.cueEnglish: Write where the water has to run.
activities.modelFrench: L’eau doit s’écouler loin de la maison.
activities.modelEnglish: The water has to run away from the house.

activities.cueEnglish: Find how the foreman checks which nails this job requires.
activities.modelFrench: Le contremaître lit les spécifications du chantier pour vérifier quels clous sont prévus.
activities.modelEnglish: The foreman reads the job specifications to see which nails the job requires.

activities.cueEnglish: Without looking, name roofing nails in French.
activities.modelFrench: les clous de toiture

activities.cueEnglish: Listen and identify plastic cap nails.
activities.modelFrench: les clous à rondelles de plastique

activities.cueEnglish: Type 'Please confirm the order.' in French.
activities.modelFrench: Veuillez confirmer la commande.

activities.cueEnglish: Ask the supplier when the materials can be delivered.
activities.modelFrench: Quand pouvez-vous les livrer ?

activities.cueEnglish: Write which two additional products the foreman needs.
activities.modelFrench: Il lui faut aussi du mastic bitumineux pour toiture et un produit d’étanchéité.
activities.modelEnglish: He also needs roofing cement and sealant.

activities.cueEnglish: Find how the crew's tasks are organized.
activities.modelFrench: Chaque personne a une tâche dans une zone de travail.
activities.modelEnglish: Each person has a task in a work zone.

activities.cueEnglish: Without looking, name an assigned task in French.
activities.modelFrench: la tâche attribuée

activities.cueEnglish: Listen and identify the word for hazard.
activities.modelFrench: le danger

activities.cueEnglish: Type 'Does everyone understand the plan?' in French.
activities.modelFrench: Tout le monde a-t-il compris le plan ?

activities.cueEnglish: Invite questions before the crew begins.
activities.modelFrench: Des questions avant de commencer ?

activities.cueEnglish: Write what a worker should report if they notice it.
activities.modelFrench: Signalez-moi tout danger que vous remarquez.
activities.modelEnglish: Tell me if you see any hazard.
